notes: Both coders found the same two university-layer documents (teaching-center page, Provost page) and agreed on stance (delegates). Main disagreements: (1) phase for syllabus-statement and sample-statement rules (before-course vs course-start vs during-work); resolved by course-start for syllabus content, during-work for rules that bind student work, general for definitions. (2) actor on informs facts (admin vs instructor vs all); resolved to all for facts addressed to every reader, admin only for a fact about the university's own tools. (3) policy_type: syllabus-statement rationale (P09 vs P95), AI-use disclosure of the guidance page itself (P48 vs P84, resolved to P84), faculty engagement (P59 vs P63), instructor AI-assessment commitment (P47 vs P46, resolved to P46), detector admissibility (P39 vs P69, resolved to P69), invite-student-to-describe-process (P64 vs P57, resolved to P57), process reflections and drafts (P26 vs P35, resolved to P35), updating course materials (P102/P44 vs P35), AI literacy (P44 vs P70); one UNCOVERED vs P57 (syllabus-clarity check, resolved to P57 with a fit_note) and one UNCOVERED kept (teach that human capacity exceeds AI). (4) unit_stance for disclosure and verification duties in permissive sample statements (require vs permit), resolved to permit because the duty attaches to allowed use. (5) modality where a template only reports instructor practice (may vs informs), resolved to informs; first-person commitments ('I will let you know', 'will not use AI to assess') resolved to must/must-not. Units found by one coder only were all kept after checking the source (A: invitation to join conversations, discipline-tailoring advice, coding-class example, instructor verification sentence, privacy-cannot-be-guaranteed reason, encourage-questions step; B: origin sentence, policy-as-discussion, deep-consideration, transparency condition, consult-first, non-AI-generated materials, materials created with AI, review of AI-drafted messages, feedback-examples disclosure, ask-questions invitation, syllabus pointer, Student Conduct Code familiarization, reinforce trust, assignment-question suggestion). Where a coder's note referred to a type that was not kept, it is preserved inside resolution_why.
